verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented bulk-operation capability, such as stopping, terminating, or updating many Pods, endpoints or volumes in one action. The CLI, REST/GraphQL APIs and MCP servers are per-resource management primitives a user could script into loops, which are developer building blocks rather than a bulk feature. The single 'Batch Inference is now generally available' line is about workload inference throughput, an adjacent feature, not bulk operations across managed items.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
